lessons.title: 10.1 Mineral Nutrition and Plant Gases
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in Mineral Nutrition and Plant Gases.

Plants require macronutrients such as nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, calcium, magnesium and sulfur, and micronutrients such as iron, zinc, copper, manganese, boron, molybdenum, chlorine and nickel. Nitrogen supports amino acids and nucleic acids; magnesium is central to chlorophyll. Carnivorous plants supplement mineral nutrition by digesting prey. Stomata regulate gas exchange and water loss; palisade mesophyll is rich in chloroplasts and is a major photosynthetic tissue.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: پودوں کو نائٹروجن، فاسفورس، پوٹاشیم، کیلشیم، میگنیشیم اور سلفر جیسے بڑے غذائی عناصر اور آئرن و زنک جیسے خرد عناصر درکار ہوتے ہیں۔ نائٹروجن پروٹین اور نیوکلیک ایسڈ، میگنیشیم کلوروفل کے لیے ضروری ہے۔ روزن گیسوں کے تبادلے اور پانی کے ضیاع کو کنٹرول کرتے ہیں۔
explanations.sd: ٻوٽن کي نائٽروجن، فاسفورس، پوٽاشيم، ڪيلشيم، ميگنيشيم ۽ سلفر جهڙا وڏا غذائي جزا ۽ لوهه ۽ زنڪ جهڙا ننڍا جزا گهرجن. نائٽروجن پروٽين ۽ نيوڪليڪ ايسڊ، ميگنيشيم ڪلوروفل لاءِ ضروري آهي. روزن گئسن جي مٽاسٽا ۽ پاڻيءَ جي نقصان کي ڪنٽرول ڪن ٿا.

lessons.title: 10.2 Xylem, Phloem and Water Potential
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in Xylem, Phloem and Water Potential.

Xylem vessels and tracheids conduct water and mineral ions; fibres provide support. Phloem sieve-tube elements and companion cells transport sugars and other organic solutes. Water moves down a water-potential gradient. Root uptake involves osmosis and pathways through cell walls (apoplast), cytoplasm (symplast) or vacuoles. The Casparian strip in the endodermis helps regulate entry into the vascular cylinder.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: زائلم کے vessels اور tracheids پانی اور معدنی آئن منتقل کرتے ہیں، جبکہ فلوئم کے sieve tubes اور companion cells شکر منتقل کرتے ہیں۔ پانی water potential کے فرق کے مطابق حرکت کرتا ہے۔ جڑ میں apoplast، symplast اور vacuolar راستے ہوتے ہیں۔
explanations.sd: زائلم جا vessels ۽ tracheids پاڻي ۽ معدني آئن کڻن ٿا، جڏهن ته فلوئم جا sieve tubes ۽ companion cells کنڊ منتقل ڪن ٿا. پاڻي water potential جي فرق موجب هلي ٿو. پاڙ ۾ apoplast، symplast ۽ vacuolar رستا هوندا آهن.

lessons.title: 10.3 Transpiration, TACT and Translocation
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in Transpiration, TACT and Translocation.

Transpiration is water loss from aerial plant surfaces, mainly through stomata. Evaporation from mesophyll creates tension that pulls a continuous water column upward in xylem: transpiration, adhesion, cohesion and tension (TACT). Stomatal opening depends on guard-cell turgor and ion movement. Sugars move in phloem from sources, such as mature leaves, to sinks, such as roots, fruits and growing tissues, through pressure-flow mechanisms.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: ٹرانسپائریشن پودے کے ہوائی حصوں سے پانی کا ضیاع ہے۔ پتوں سے تبخیر زائلم میں کھنچاؤ پیدا کرتی ہے جو پانی کو اوپر کھینچتا ہے؛ اسے TACT کہتے ہیں۔ فلوئم شکر کو source سے sink تک منتقل کرتا ہے۔
explanations.sd: ٽرانسپائريشن ٻوٽي جي هوائي حصن مان پاڻيءَ جو نقصان آهي. پنن مان بخار ٿيڻ زائلم ۾ ڇڪ پيدا ڪري ٿو، جيڪو پاڻي مٿي کڻي ٿو؛ ان کي TACT چئبو آهي. فلوئم کنڊ کي source کان sink تائين منتقل ڪري ٿو.

lessons.title: 10.4 Homeostasis, Support and Adaptation
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in Homeostasis, Support and Adaptation.

Osmotic adjustment helps plant cells maintain water balance. In hypotonic surroundings cells gain water and become turgid; in hypertonic surroundings they lose water and may plasmolyse. Hydrophytes, mesophytes and xerophytes show different adaptations to water availability; halophytes tolerate high salinity. Turgor supports herbaceous plants. Collenchyma provides flexible support; sclerenchyma provides strong support. Plants also respond to heat and cold through structural and physiological adjustments.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: اوسموٹک ایڈجسٹمنٹ پودوں کے خلیوں میں پانی کا توازن برقرار رکھتی ہے۔ hypotonic ماحول میں خلیہ پانی لے کر turgid ہوتا ہے جبکہ hypertonic ماحول میں پانی کھو سکتا ہے۔ hydrophytes، mesophytes، xerophytes اور halophytes مختلف ماحول سے مطابقت رکھتے ہیں۔
explanations.sd: اوسموٽڪ ايڊجسٽمينٽ ٻوٽن جي خلين ۾ پاڻيءَ جو توازن برقرار رکي ٿي. hypotonic ماحول ۾ خليو پاڻي وٺي turgid ٿئي ٿو، جڏهن ته hypertonic ماحول ۾ پاڻي وڃائي سگهي ٿو. hydrophytes، mesophytes، xerophytes ۽ halophytes مختلف ماحول سان ٺهڪندڙ آهن.

lessons.title: 10.5 Growth, Hormones and Tropisms
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in Growth, Hormones and Tropisms.

Primary growth increases length through apical meristems; secondary growth increases girth through vascular and cork cambia. Annual rings reflect seasonal differences in secondary xylem. Auxin promotes cell elongation and apical dominance; gibberellins promote stem elongation and seed germination; cytokinins promote cell division; abscisic acid supports stress responses and dormancy; ethylene promotes fruit ripening. Tropisms are directional growth responses: phototropism to light, gravitropism to gravity, thigmotropism to touch and chemotropism to chemicals.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: ابتدائی نشوونما apical meristem سے لمبائی بڑھاتی ہے، جبکہ ثانوی نشوونما cambium سے موٹائی بڑھاتی ہے۔ آکسن خلیاتی لمبائی اور apical dominance، gibberellin بیج کے اگاؤ، cytokinin تقسیم، ABA دباؤ اور ethylene پھل پکنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔
explanations.sd: ابتدائي واڌ apical meristem سان ڊيگهه وڌائي ٿي، جڏهن ته ثانوي واڌ cambium سان ٿولهه وڌائي ٿي. آڪسن خلوي ڊيگهه ۽ apical dominance، gibberellin ٻج جي اڀرڻ، cytokinin ورهاست، ABA دٻاءَ ۽ ethylene ڦر پچڻ ۾ مدد ڪري ٿو.

اوسموٹک ایڈجسٹمنٹ پودوں کے خلیوں میں پانی کا توازن برقرار رکھتی ہے۔ hypotonic ماحول میں خلیہ پانی لے کر turgid ہوتا ہے جبکہ hypertonic ماحول میں پانی کھو سکتا ہے۔ hydrophytes، mesophytes، xerophytes اور halophytes مختلف ماحول سے مطابقت رکھتے ہیں۔
rubric: بنیادی تصورات کی درست وضاحت (4 نمبر)
ساخت اور فعل کا تعلق (3 نمبر)

sd.question: Form and Functions of Plants ۾ شامل اهم نظامن يا گروهن جي بناوت، ڪم ۽ اهميت مثالن سان بيان ڪريو.
sd.modelAnswer:
ٻوٽن کي نائٽروجن، فاسفورس، پوٽاشيم، ڪيلشيم، ميگنيشيم ۽ سلفر جهڙا وڏا غذائي جزا ۽ لوهه ۽ زنڪ جهڙا ننڍا جزا گهرجن. نائٽروجن پروٽين ۽ نيوڪليڪ ايسڊ، ميگنيشيم ڪلوروفل لاءِ ضروري آهي. روزن گئسن جي مٽاسٽا ۽ پاڻيءَ جي نقصان کي ڪنٽرول ڪن ٿا.

زائلم جا vessels ۽ tracheids پاڻي ۽ معدني آئن کڻن ٿا، جڏهن ته فلوئم جا sieve tubes ۽ companion cells کنڊ منتقل ڪن ٿا. پاڻي water potential جي فرق موجب هلي ٿو. پاڙ ۾ apoplast، symplast ۽ vacuolar رستا هوندا آهن.

ٽرانسپائريشن ٻوٽي جي هوائي حصن مان پاڻيءَ جو نقصان آهي. پنن مان بخار ٿيڻ زائلم ۾ ڇڪ پيدا ڪري ٿو، جيڪو پاڻي مٿي کڻي ٿو؛ ان کي TACT چئبو آهي. فلوئم کنڊ کي source کان sink تائين منتقل ڪري ٿو.

اوسموٽڪ ايڊجسٽمينٽ ٻوٽن جي خلين ۾ پاڻيءَ جو توازن برقرار رکي ٿي. hypotonic ماحول ۾ خليو پاڻي وٺي turgid ٿئي ٿو، جڏهن ته hypertonic ماحول ۾ پاڻي وڃائي سگهي ٿو. hydrophytes، mesophytes، xerophytes ۽ halophytes مختلف ماحول سان ٺهڪندڙ آهن.
rubric: بنيادي تصورن جي صحيح وضاحت (4 مارڪون)

writtenQuestions.question: Evaluate the biological importance, applications and limitations of the concepts in Form and Functions of Plants.
writtenQuestions.modelAnswer:
Xylem vessels and tracheids conduct water and mineral ions; fibres provide support. Phloem sieve-tube elements and companion cells transport sugars and other organic solutes. Water moves down a water-potential gradient. Root uptake involves osmosis and pathways through cell walls (apoplast), cytoplasm (symplast) or vacuoles. The Casparian strip in the endodermis helps regulate entry into the vascular cylinder.

Transpiration is water loss from aerial plant surfaces, mainly through stomata. Evaporation from mesophyll creates tension that pulls a continuous water column upward in xylem: transpiration, adhesion, cohesion and tension (TACT). Stomatal opening depends on guard-cell turgor and ion movement. Sugars move in phloem from sources, such as mature leaves, to sinks, such as roots, fruits and growing tissues, through pressure-flow mechanisms.

Osmotic adjustment helps plant cells maintain water balance. In hypotonic surroundings cells gain water and become turgid; in hypertonic surroundings they lose water and may plasmolyse. Hydrophytes, mesophytes and xerophytes show different adaptations to water availability; halophytes tolerate high salinity. Turgor supports herbaceous plants. Collenchyma provides flexible support; sclerenchyma provides strong support. Plants also respond to heat and cold through structural and physiological adjustments.

Primary growth increases length through apical meristems; secondary growth increases girth through vascular and cork cambia. Annual rings reflect seasonal differences in secondary xylem. Auxin promotes cell elongation and apical dominance; gibberellins promote stem elongation and seed germination; cytokinins promote cell division; abscisic acid supports stress responses and dormancy; ethylene promotes fruit ripening. Tropisms are directional growth responses: phototropism to light, gravitropism to gravity, thigmotropism to touch and chemotropism to chemicals.
rubric: Evaluation of significance and limitations (3 marks)
